items.desc: A durable iron pot showing no signs of use. It probably belongs to someone who is picky about cooking utensils.

items.name: Jar of Sweets
items.desc: A jar filled with sweets. It probably belongs to someone with a sweet tooth.

items.name: Jousting Almanac
items.desc: A record of jousting matches held in Faerghus. It probably belongs to someone who looks up to knights.

items.name: Leather Bow Sheath
items.desc: A leather bow sheath engraved with an unfamiliar script. It seems like something Claude would own.

items.name: Lens Cloth
items.desc: A clean white cloth decorated with fine embroidery. It probably belongs to someone who wears glasses.

items.name: Letter to Rhea
items.desc: A letter that seems to be written to Rhea. It probably belongs to someone with a deep connection to Rhea.

items.name: Letter to the Goddess
items.desc: An impassioned letter written to the goddess. It probably belongs to someone who daydreams about the goddess.

items.name: Light Purple Veil
items.desc: A headscarf that has been dyed purple. It probably belongs to someone who likes fashion.

items.name: Lovely Comb
items.desc: A beautiful red comb made from tortoiseshell. It probably belongs to someone who takes care of their long hair.

items.name: Maintenance Oil
items.desc: A jar containing oil for weapon maintenance. It probably belongs to someone who collects weapons.

items.name: Makeup brush
items.desc: A thin brush for applying makeup around the eyes. It probably belongs to someone who wears eyeshadow.

items.name: Mild Stomach Poison
items.desc: A small bottle labeled "Mild Stomach Poison" that seems fairly harmless. It probably belongs to a schemer.

items.name: Moon Knight's Tale
items.desc: A story recorded during the Crescent Moon War. It probably belongs to someone who reads tales of chivalry.

items.name: Mysterious Notebook
items.desc: A notebook full of cheesy jokes and bad puns. It probably belongs to someone who likes telling jokes.

items.name: Needle and Thread
items.desc: A needle and a spool of thread. They probably belong to someone who hides away doing needlework.

items.name: New Bottle of Perfume
items.desc: An unopened bottle containing fancy perfume. It probably belongs to someone who doesn't often wear perfume.

items.name: Nimbus Charm
items.desc: A cursed charm said to summon clouds. Its efficacy is dubious. Likely belongs to someone who avoids sunlight.

items.name: Noseless Puppet
items.desc: An exquisitely crafted, but incomplete, wooden puppet. It probably belongs to someone who enjoys woodcarving.

items.name: Noxious Handkerchief
items.desc: A handkerchief soaked in a strange chemical. It probably belongs to someone who is callous in their methods.

items.name: Old Cleaning Cloth
items.desc: An old cleaning cloth with a Crest-like design. It probably belongs to someone who worked for a noble house.

items.name: Old Fishing Rod
items.desc: A well-used fishing rod with no hook. It probably belongs to a fisher who doesn't care about how much they catch.

items.name: Old Map of Enbarr
items.desc: An old map of Enbarr. It probably belongs to someone with a connection to the Imperial capital of the past.

items.name: Pegasus Horseshoes
items.desc: Special horseshoes commonly used by Pegasus Knights. They probably belong to someone who values chivalry.

items.name: Portrait of Rhea
items.desc: A portrait of Rhea made for a believer. It probably belongs to someone with an emotional attachment to Rhea.

items.name: Princess Doll
items.desc: A doll that was hidden in a leather bag for magic tools. It probably belongs to someone who secretly loves dolls.

items.name: Rare Item Index
items.desc: A list of rare items in Fódlan. It probably belongs to someone with a deep interest in rare things...

items.name: Repellent Powder
items.desc: A powder derived from insect-repellent flowers. It probably belongs to someone who hates bugs.

items.name: School of Sorcery Book
items.desc: A textbook from the Kingdom's School of Sorcery. It probably belongs to someone who went to that school.

items.name: Secret Ledger
items.desc: Countless numbers are listed in this ledger. It probably belongs to someone deeply involved in commerce.

items.name: Seiros Scriptures
items.desc: A book of old scriptures engraved with the Crest of Seiros It probably belongs to someone affiliated with the church.

items.name: Shiny Striated Pebble
items.desc: A small stone streaked with colorful lines. It probably belongs to someone who likes collecting pebbles.

items.name: Silk Handkercheif
items.desc: A fine white silk handkerchief. It probably belongs to a noble who cares about their personal grooming.

items.name: Silver Necklace
items.desc: A silver necklace engraved with the Crest of Seiros. It probably belongs to a devout believer.

items.name: Silver Brooch
items.desc: A broach depicting the Mittlefrank Opera Company logo. It probably belongs to someone involved with the opera.

items.name: Sketch of a Sigil
items.desc: A drawing of a circle used to activate magic. It probably belongs to someone interested in magic and Crests.

items.name: Small Tanned Hide
items.desc: A small animal's hide which has been meticulously tanned. It probably belongs to a skilled hunter.

items.name: Snapped Writing Quill
items.desc: A writing quill that has snapped from overuse. It probably belongs to someone who does lots of paperwork.

items.name: Songstress Poster
items.desc: A poster promoting Manuela, the "Miracle Songstress." It probably belongs to someone who looks up to her.

items.name: Spotless Bandage
items.desc: A bandage that is clean depite being used. It probably belongs to someone who was slacking on their training.

items.name: Stiff Hand Wrap
items.desc: A hand bandage splotched with blood, as though used in a fist fight. It probably belongs to a seasoned brawler.

items.name: Still-Life Picture
items.desc: A still-life painting that features an unusual flower. It probably belongs to someone who is fond of art.

items.name: Suspicious Dice
items.desc: Dice that always produce the same results when thrown. They probably belong to a skilled swindler.

items.name: Sword Belt Fragment
items.desc: A metal piece from a sword belt that broke due to wear. It probably belongs to someone who is devoted to training.

items.name: Tattered Overcoat
items.desc: An overcoat with many holes and tears. It probably belongs to someone who often finds themselves in fights.

items.name: The History of Sreng
items.desc: A book recording the history of the Sreng people. It probably belongs to someone who has ties to Sreng.

items.name: The Saints Revealed
items.desc: An unofficial account of the Four Saints' deeds during the War of Heroes. It probably belongs to a history buff.

items.name: Thunderbrand Replica
items.desc: A training sword modeled after Thunderbrand. It probably belongs to someone who is enthusiastic about training.

items.name: Time-worn Quill Pen
items.desc: Writing utensil adorned with a beautiful black feather. It probably belongs to someone who often writes letters.

items.name: Toothed Dagger
items.desc: A uniquely shaped dagger, the back of which is toothed. It probably belongs to someone who likes rare weapons.

items.name: Training Logbook
items.desc: A detailed record of someone's combat training. It probably belongs to someone who trains relentlessly.

items.name: Unfinished Fable
items.desc: A children's fable that ends partway through. It probably belongs to someone who likes writing stories.

items.name: Unfinished Score
items.desc: Score music with unusual lyrics written in by hand. It probably belongs to someone who likes to sing.

items.name: Unused Lipstick
items.desc: Lipstick that would make an ideal gift for a young lady. It probably belongs to someone who likes wooing women.

items.name: Used Bottle of Perfume
items.desc: A bottle containing a rare perfume. It probably belongs to someone who is particular about fashion.

items.name: Wax Dipthych
items.desc: A wax diptych that has been thoroughly used. It probably belongs to someone who is zealous about studying.

items.name: Weathered Cloak
items.desc: A thick, but rather worn-out cloak. It probably belongs to someone who battles enemies outdoors.

items.name: White Glove
items.desc: A pure white glove sewn from high-quality material. It seems like something that Edelgard would own.

items.name: Wellness Herbs
items.desc: Herbs that aid with persistent headaches. They probably belong to an adult with a taste for liquor.

items.name: Well-Used Hatchet
items.desc: A hatchet with a wide variety of potential uses. It probably belongs to someone who frequently works outside.

items.name: Well-Worn Hammock
items.desc: A Dadgan cot for sleeping outside. It probably belongs to someone with a history of roaming from place to place.

items.name: Wooden Button
items.desc: A button that seems to have popped off a man's shirt. It probably belongs to someone with a large physique.

items.name: Wooden Flask
items.desc: A flask that gives off a strong alcoholic smell when opened. You seem to recall Jeralt keeping it on his person.

items.name: Flayn's Bait
items.desc: Bait given to you by Flayn to catch your first fish! Try it out at the fishing pond.

items.name: Insect Larva
items.desc: All-purpose bait that often attracts everyday fish.

items.name: Pond Snail
items.desc: Freshwater snail that occasionally attracts uncommon fish.

items.name: Earthworm
items.desc: A wriggling bait, optimal for catching uncommon fish.

items.name: Blowfly
items.desc: A favorable bait that is optimal for hooking extremely rare fish.

items.name: Herring Bait
items.desc: Live small fish bait that attracts extremely rare fish.

items.name: Tournament Bait
items.desc: Bait used only in the Fishing Tournament

items.name: Dedue's Seeds
items.desc: Seeds given to you by Dedue to grow a vegetable for him. Try planting them in the greenhouse.

items.name: Mixed Fruit Seeds
items.desc: A mixture of various seeds. It's a mystery what they are until they've fully sprouted!

items.name: Mixed Herb Seeds
items.desc: A handful of mixed herbal seeds. Plant them in the greenhouse to see what becomes of them!

items.name: Root Vegetable Seeds
items.desc: A sprinkling of mixed root vegetable seeds. You won't know which types until you plant them.

items.name: Vegetable Seeds
items.desc: Mixed vegetable seeds. Results may vary.

items.name: Western Fódlan Seeds
items.desc: Mixed seeds foraged from the western region of Fódlan.

items.name: Eastern Fódlan Seeds
items.desc: These mixed seeds have been gathered from the eastern regions of Fódlan.

items.name: Albinean Seeds
items.desc: A mixture of seeds that have been foraged from Albinea.

items.name: Morfis Seeds
items.desc: Mixed seeds foraged from Morfis.

items.name: Northern Fódlan Seeds
items.desc: Mixed seeds foraged from the northern region of Fódlan.

items.name: Southern Fódlan Seeds
items.desc: Mixed seeds foraged from the southern region of Fódlan.

items.name: Blue Flower Seeds
items.desc: A palmful of seeds that will grow bright blue flowers.

items.name: Pale-Blue Flower Seeds
items.desc: These seeds yield brillient, aqua flowers.

items.name: Purple Flower Seeds
items.desc: These seeds yield deep purple flowers.

items.name: Red Flower Seeds
items.desc: Rich red flowers sprout from these seeds when planted.

items.name: Green Flower Seeds
items.desc: Seeds that grow earthy green flowers.

items.name: Yellow Flower Seeds
items.desc: A handful of seeds that grow vibrant yellow flowers.

items.name: White Flower Seeds
items.desc: Bright white flowers will grow from these seeds.

items.name: Morfis-Plum Seeds
items.desc: Seeds derived from Morfis plums. Planting them will yield Morfis plums.

items.name: Nordsalat Seeds
items.desc: Seeds derived from nordsalat. Planting them will yield nordsalat.

items.name: Angelica Seeds
items.desc: Hand-selected seeds taken from the angelica plant. Plant these to grow more angelica.

items.name: Boa-Fruit Seeds
items.desc: Seeds derived from boa fruit. Planting them will yield boa fruit.

items.name: Smithing Stone
items.desc: A basic smithing material. Can be used to repair broken weapons.

items.name: Black-Sand Steel
items.desc: A smithing material that strengthens a weapon's critical attack.

items.name: Arcane Crystal
items.desc: A smithing material that glows with magical light.

items.name: Agarthium
items.desc: A smithing material refined using archaic methods.

items.name: Wootz Steel
items.desc: A smithing material that is both light and durable.

items.name: Mythril
items.desc: A smithing material blessed with holy might.

items.name: Umbral Steel
items.desc: A smithing material steeped in the power of darkness.

items.name: Venomstone
items.desc: A highly toxic smithing material that should be handled with great care.

items.name: Carassius
items.desc: This small fish is common to all regions of Fódlan. It is somehow connected to Saint Cethleann.

items.name: Airmid Goby
items.desc: A small fish found throughout the waters of Fódlan. These fish can be eaten but aren't particularly tasty...

items.name: Caledonian Crayfish
items.desc: A hard-shelled crayfish that hides beneath pebbles in rapid water. Can be used when you share a meal.

items.name: Albinean Herring
items.desc: An intense swimmer who migrates over vast distances near the coast of Albinea. Can be used when you share a meal.

items.name: Teutates Loach
items.desc: A stately bearded fish from Lake Teutates. Can be used when you share a meal.

items.name: White Trout
items.desc: A stark white fish that gleams in sunlight. Can be used when you share a meal.

items.name: Airmid Pike
items.desc: This fish is commonly found in the Airmid River. Can be used when you share a meal.

items.name: Caledonian Gar
items.desc: This fish has very hard scales, signifying its origins on the Caledonian Plateau. Can be used when you share a meal.

items.name: Silverfish
items.desc: A somewhat costly fish that glimmers like polished silver.

items.name: Golden Fish
items.desc: Glittering gold, this fish boasts a high cost.

items.name: Queen Loach
items.desc: A beautiful specimen, even among Teutates loaches. Cook into a dish to boost dexterity.

items.name: Teutates Pike
items.desc: This fish is a cross between loaches and pikes spawned in Lake Teutates. Cook into a dish that boosts defense.

items.name: Bullhead
items.desc: This fish has a hard head that is used for defending itself against predators. Cook into a dish that boosts speed.

items.name: Platinum Fish
items.desc: This pricey fish shines like pure white silver.

items.name: Fódlandy
items.desc: Challenging to ensnare, this ancient fish has swum in the waters of Fódlan for countless generations.

items.name: Goddess Messenger
items.desc: Appears only when the water shines with spectral light... Cook into a dish that boosts dexterity, speed, and defense.

items.name: Dried Vegetables
items.desc: Parched vegetables that are no longer useful for cooking.

items.name: Weeds
items.desc: Common weeds. Not much to look at, and not of much use either.

items.name: Zanado Fruit
items.desc: A simple fruit found in Zanado that is ill tasting and inedible.

items.name: Cabbage
items.desc: Cabbage of Fódlan that is enjoyed in a number of dishes. Can be used when you share a meal.

items.name: Carrot
items.desc: A simple carrot grown in Fódlan that adds texture to any recipe. Can be used when you share a meal.

items.name: Chickpeas
items.desc: Chickpeas harvested throughout Fódlan. Can be used when you share a meal.

items.name: Noa Fruit
items.desc: A fruit named after Saint Noa. It takes a skilled hand to extract the pulp. Can be used when you share a meal.

items.name: Onion
items.desc: A Fódlan onion—a staple in many dishes. Can be used when you share a meal.

items.name: Tomato
items.desc: A rare vegetable from Dagda that requires delicate conditions to thrive. Can be used when you share a meal.

items.name: Turnip
items.desc: A Fódlan turnip. Tasty and earthy. Can be used when you share a meal.

items.name: Albinean Berries
items.desc: Simple Albinean berries that are tart with a hint of sweetness. Can be used when you share a meal.

items.name: Peach Currant
items.desc: Sweet peach currants. Can be used when you share a meal.

items.name: Verona
items.desc: Blessed by the goddess herself, this vegetable is as tasty as it is beautiful. Can be used when you share a meal.

items.name: Magdred Kirsch
items.desc: A shimmering fruit, warm and glowing with Magdred magics. Can be cooked into a dish.

items.name: Morfis Plum
items.desc: It is said that mages of old infused these plums with their spells. Cook into a dish that boosts luck.

items.name: Nordsalat
items.desc: A magical vegetable that grows in frigid, unyielding environments. Cook into a dish that boosts charm.

items.name: Ailell Grass
items.desc: This rare fiery-colored grass thrives in the harsh environs of Ailell and is sold for a high price.

items.name: Angelica
items.desc: This unearthly vegetable is purportedly grown from the blood of fallen heroes. Cook into a dish that boosts magic.

items.name: Boa Fruit
items.desc: Serpentine scales of this fruit protect the delectable pulp nestled within. Cook into a dish that boosts resistance.

items.name: Zanado Treasure Fruit
items.desc: A prized fruit as red as blood that grows in Zanado. Cook into a dish that boosts magic and resistance.

items.name: Poultry
items.desc: Meat from birds hunted in the hills. Can be used when you share a meal.

items.name: Wild Game
items.desc: Meat from beasts hunted in the hills. Can be used when you share a meal.

items.name: Duscur Bear
items.desc: Meat from rare bears of Duscur with a dense flavor profile. Cook into a dish that raises a unit's max HP.

items.name: Oghma Wolverine
items.desc: This meat is taken from fleet-footed beasts found in the Oghma Mountains. Cook into a dish that boosts strength.

items.name: Albinean Moose
items.desc: Albinean moose meat—highly prized in Fódlan and rare to find. Cook into a dish that raises max HP and strength.

items.name: Tea of the Saints
items.desc: Even commoners have tried this cost-efficient tea, which is a mixture of herbs. It's a tad bitter.

items.name: Sweet-Apple Blend
items.desc: A tea blended with two types of apple peels. Elegant and sweet, it is popular among common folk and nobles alike.

items.name: Albinean Berry Blend
items.desc: Dried Albinean berries give this black tea its fragrance. The sweet, relaxing scent is popular among many.

items.name: Southern Fruit Blend
items.desc: A blend with a unique dried fruit from the south. Popular for its intoxicatingly strong, bright notes.

items.name: Mint Leaves
items.desc: An invigorating mint blend that revitalizes and refreshes all who partake.

items.name: Almond Blend
items.desc: A refined, nutty tea that is blended with leaves and thinly sliced almonds.

items.name: Ginger Tea
items.desc: The sharp spiciness of ginger laces the body of this tea, unforgettable and brightening.

items.name: Angelica Tea
items.desc: A cleansing herbal tea blended with angelica.

items.name: Almyran Pine Needles
items.desc: This tea is comprised of oxidized pine needles from eastern Almyra, giving it a distinct, earthy tone.

items.name: Crescent-Moon Tea
items.desc: Fermented dried seeds blended with tea leaves. It has a soft and subtle flavor, akin to the gentle light of the moon.

items.name: Honeyed-Fruit Blend
items.desc: A candied blend made up of dried, honeyed fruits. For anyone with a sweet tooth, this tea can't be beat.

items.name: Lavender Blend
items.desc: Tiny dried purple lavandula flowers are sprinkled into this refreshing floral tea.

items.name: Chamomile
items.desc: A stark white floral tea with bright notes, this blend calms nerves and heightens concentration.

items.name: Bergamot
items.desc: The bright notes of this tea stem from an infusion of citrus oils. This blend is highly favored by nobility.

items.name: Cinnamon Blend
items.desc: An aromatic bark blend referred to as the king of spices. Its unique taste appeals to similarly unique people.

items.name: Dagda Fruit Blend
items.desc: A stark, bitter fruit from Dagda makes this black tea particularly pungent. Connoisseurs enjoy its unique flavor.

items.name: Rose Petal Blend
items.desc: Black tea laced with rose petals. A classic floral blend often enjoyed among Kingdom and Alliance nobles.

items.name: Seiros Tea
items.desc: A black tea common to the south of Almyra, it is fairly basic in its flavors. This is its common name in Fódlan.

items.name: Four-Spice Blend
items.desc: A novelty tea blended with four unique spices inspired by the Four Saints. Enjoyment requires a mature palate.

items.name: Hresvelg Blend
items.desc: A high-quality blend of leaves procured specially for House Hresvelg. Its refined flavor brings sheer bliss.

items.name: Leicester Cortania
items.desc: A specialty tea from the Alliance blended with a variety of leaves from the east. This tea is of the utmost quality.

presets.name: FE Adventurer Pack
presets.desc: Healing, light and a shield for a first outing.

presets.name: FE Healer Satchel
presets.desc: Everything a field healer keeps to hand.

presets.name: FE Angler Kit
presets.desc: Bait for a day at the pond.
